svg.title: Representative Playbook adoption patterns / 代表性 Playbook 落地型態
svg.desc: Four repository patterns show how shared Playbook methodology can coexist with different project-specific governance, routing, coordination, and domain ownership structures. / 四種 repository 型態展示共通 Playbook 方法論如何與不同的專案治理、routing、coordination 與 domain ownership 共存。
svg.text: Representative Adoption Patterns / 代表性落地型態
Same semantic architecture; different repository shapes.
AI Development Playbook
shared methodology / routing / execution / validation / context semantics
Only activates when the current project route needs shared governance.
Conditional activation / 條件式啟用
Public method Playbook — ai-divination-playbook
• Project-native ordinary-reading hot path
• Method owners keep divination-specific truth
• Shared development governance activates for maintenance
Recursive ownership example:
ASTROLOGY root owner → Natal owner / Transit owner
common invariants up; mode-specific policy stays in mode owners
Embedded product pattern — generalized
• Project governance keeps hardware / protocol / security truth
• Shared bootstrap / model / validation methodology stays upstream
• TASKS remains current Hot coordination
Key separation:
governance normalization ≠ product-state or validation reset
Data-analysis product pattern — generalized
• AGENTS keeps project mapping and mutation boundary
• TASKS = current Hot; BACKLOG = Cold registry
• Product truth remains in the product owner
Result:
future work stays durable without entering executable context
Public engineering KB — building-envelope-engineering-kb
• CHAT_INIT keeps the project-native retrieval hot path
• knowledge-index → domain manifest → canonical leaf
• Local validation file owns only the KB-specific recipe
Shared Playbook activates for:
repository / workflow governance, execution, validation, context work
Representative examples, not a mandatory file template. Public repositories are named; non-public examples are generalized.
這些是代表性責任分層，不是固定檔案模板；公開範例直接命名，非公開範例則泛化處理。
Canonical authority remains in each repository's governance and routed owners.
